basic_info.description: Welcome to 210 Edinburgh Street - A Rare Gem in the Excelsior District    On the market for the first time in 60 years, this charming four-bedroom, two-bath home is full of warmth, character, and potential. Located in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Excelsior neighborhood, 210 Edinburgh offers an ideal layout for comfortable living and entertaining.    The upper level features two spacious bedrooms and one full bath, complemented by a formal living room, a dining area, and a large, sun-filled kitchen with ample counter space perfect for home chefs and family gatherings. Downstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms and a second full bath, offering flexible space for guests, home office, or extended family.    Fresh interior paint and new flooring give the home a clean, updated feel, while classic architectural details provide timeless charm. Enjoy the large backyardideal for gardening, play, or future expansionand a one-car garage with additional storage space.    Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a sunshine house on a quiet block, close to local shops, public transportation, and parks. Come make 210 Edinburgh your forever home!
